explication: ripgrep is a command-line tool for recursively searching files and reporting matches. Its principal flow parses options, discovers eligible paths, searches file contents with a selected regex engine, and prints results. The README also documents file-type filtering, decompression and preprocessors, alternate output formats, and optional PCRE2 and indexing. The graph follows the sampled entry-point and worker evidence; some subsystem connections are based on documented capabilities and are omitted where exact call wiring was not sampled.
